thread:
mike_sales: Heads up — closed SignalFlow contract today. They committed to Dedicated capacity (6 GPUs) + Private deployment (VPC). Signed SOW attached in CRM. Go-live target: 2024-12-15. Primary asks: SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS, and SOC2 audit artifacts. Renewal conversation expected in 11 months.

leah_cs: Thanks @mike_sales — I’ll take primary CS ownership. I’ll run kickoff next Tue. Can someone from Eng own the VPC/connectivity work? Also flagging potential renewal risk: legal wants an explicit data residency clause.

raj_eng: I can own the VPC onboarding + infra QA. Need contact from their infra team and their allowed IP ranges. ETA to produce a network diagram + runbook: 2 weeks (2024-11-01).

mike_sales: Contact is emily@signalflow.io (infra lead). She said they'd prefer a test window before full cutover. Billing: they requested a hard usage cap in month 1.

leah_cs: Plan: 1) Kickoff + SSO scoping (owner: leah_cs) — due 2024-10-25; 2) VPC + routing (owner: raj_eng) — due 2024-11-01; 3) KMS integration (owner: raj_eng + leah_cs) — due 2024-11-08; 4) Support onboarding + runbooks (owner: kai_support) — due 2024-11-15. I’ll send calendar invites after kickoff sync.

kai_support: I’ll prepare a support runbook and escalation matrix. Please share any custom log or audit requirements. Also recommend we enable increased observability for first 30 days (token-level tracing + per-route latency).

raj_eng: Noted. For KMS we'll need key policy details and whether they use AWS KMS or HSM. If HSM, we'll need the cert exchange step. Small snippet of required info to send to customer:

```
- Allowed egress CIDRs
- SAML IdP metadata (base64 or URL)
- KMS provider and key ID
- Expected burst RPS and avg seq length
```

leah_cs: @mike_sales can you confirm Emily gets the checklist above? I’ll also capture these in the Signals workspace doc (link to internal doc).

mike_sales: Confirmed — I’ll intro in an email right after this thread.

infra-bot: [automated] New account created in onboarding tracker: SignalFlow (acct id: SF-8891). Status: onboarding_started. Owner: leah_cs.

leah_cs: Action owners & short next steps:
- leah_cs: Schedule kickoff + capture SSO/KMS requirements (by 2024-10-25)
- raj_eng: Draft VPC network diagram + security checklist (by 2024-11-01)
- kai_support: Build runbook + 30d observability plan (by 2024-11-15)
- mike_sales: Intro email to SignalFlow infra + confirm billing cap (today)

leah_cs: Renewal risk notes: legal requested data residency clause; work with product/compliance if they need changes to default terms. Flagging as medium risk — keep close during first 90 days.

kai_support: Will set up a shared incident channel for the cutover and add oncall rotation.

raj_eng: If we hit infra blockers during test window, recommend fallback to Hosted with IP restrictions until Private is green — need approval from CS + Sales for fallback cost model.

mike_sales: Good call. I’ll keep sales leadership in loop. Thanks team — I’ll send the intro now and update CRM.

leah_cs: Thanks everyone — I’ll post meeting notes and owners in the onboarding tracker after kickoff. :white_check_mark:
